notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד i tanim olsem khesed, i no marimari tasol — em i strongpela marimari bilong kontrak

notes.subject: emet
notes.rationale: אמת i 'stret, wanpela, i no senis' — emet i holim wanpela as bilong emet

notes.subject: i strongpela long olgeta samting
notes.rationale: גבר עלינו i ken tok 'i winim yumi' o 'i strong long yumi' — mi usim strongpela long olgeta samting

translation: Long wanem, khesed bilong em i strongpela long olgeta samting antiap long yumi, na emet bilong Yahwe i stap oltaim olgeta; yu ol i singautim nem bilong Ya.

tokens.gloss: yu ol i singautim nem bilong
